description: This file defines an abstraction for a download engine and a data class representing a download record, used in a Flutter (Dart) project to manage downloads within the app. The comments indicate it is a minimal placeholder implementation for testing purposes.

classes.name: DownloadEngine
classes.description: An abstract class that declares methods for managing download tasks such as enqueueing, canceling, listing downloads, and retrieving downloads by content ID.

classes.name: DownloadRecord
classes.description: A data class representing individual download information, including content ID, title, status, progress, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Public method to add a new download task with specified content ID and title.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Public method to cancel an ongoing download identified by content ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Public method to retrieve a list of all current download records.

methods.name: getByContentId
methods.description: Public method to retrieve a specific download record by its content ID.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Method to create a copy of a DownloadRecord with optional updated status or progress.
